title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 68. Takes note of the ‘ReArm Europe’ plan presented by the Commission President and endorsed by the Council; recalls that the absence of new EU own resources means that the Member States will have to increase their contribution to the EU budget to repay the loans backed by the EU budget of up to EUR 150 billion; stresses that this reimbursement will be additional to the repayment of NextGenerationEU debt;
